propositions: Failed identity writes in dispatch_one currently delete successfully-created Jira issues as part of exception handling, destroying recoverable work
Rollback delete leaves keyed-pending bindings with dead keys that permanently strand local tickets in failed state on subsequent recovery passes
The keyed-pending recovery path already exists and requires no Jira search, making rollback deletion redundant with rebar's own recovery machinery
Jira rejects identity field writes with misleading screen-not-found errors in at least three distinct cases: missing screen configuration, workflow permission denial, or malformed field values
The fix is to stop deleting issues, retain keyed-pending bindings for deterministic retro-attach completion, and declare labels as a required screen configuration
Documentation must state that labels field must be present on project Create and Edit screens, following Sentry integration's precedent of explicit scope boundaries
